title: How to knit MAGIC LOOP | Beginners easy tutorial
description:
Learn to knit projects in the round using the magic loop technique! This easy beginner tutorial is great for making small circles, perfect for baby beanies, snoods, part of a toy, sleeves, socks and much more. All you need is your fave yarn, circular knitting needles and these easy steps to get started! In this tutorial Merion will be using stocking stitch. 

MATERIALS
Yarn - https://www.lovecrafts.com/l/yarns/yarns-by-weight/chunky-yarn
Circular Knitting Needles  https://www.lovecrafts.com/en-gb/p/knitpro-symfonie-circular-needles-80cm
